0022600225.text: The Golden State Warriors (8-3, 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, 3rd in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (8-3, 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, 5th in the West) in the Warriors' 12th game of the season, with both teams having played 11 games so far. The Warriors are on an eight-game winning streak, going 8-2 over their last ten and 2-2 on the road, while the Rockets are 5-1 at home and 7-3 over their last ten. The season series is tied at no games in 2026-27, the Warriors lost 1-2 to the Rockets in 2025-26, and their last meeting on April 5, 2026, in San Francisco ended in a 117-116 Warriors loss, while Golden State is without Brandon Williams, Gary Payton II, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody, with Will Richard listed as day-to-day with a thumb injury and a game-time decision, and Houston is without Clint Capela and Steven Adams.
